blocks.text: CEBU CITY — Fire broke out aboard a water vessel docked at Pier 5 in the North Reclamation Area, Barangay Tejero, Cebu City, on Friday morning, Nov. 13, 2026, leaving an estimated ₱5 million in damages. The affected vessel was identified by the Cebu Port Authority (CPA) as Trans-Asia 21. According to the Cebu City Fire Station, the fire was reported at 8:51 a.m. Responding fire units arrived at the scene within five minutes, immediately raising the incident to the first alarm at 8:57 a.m. The CPA said the fire originated from a forklift truck that caught fire while onboard the […]...
